function.name: read
function.description:
Read a file or directory from the local filesystem.

Usage:
- filePath is the file or directory to read.
- By default, returns up to 2000 lines from the start.
- offset is the line number to start reading from (1-indexed).
- To read later sections, call again with a larger offset.
- Use grep to find specific content in large files.
- Use glob if you are unsure of the file path.
- File lines are prefixed as <line>: <content>.
- Directory entries are returned one per line with / suffix for directories.
- Lines longer than 2000 characters are truncated.

filePath.description: The path to the file or directory to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read (defaults to 2000)

function.name: write
function.description:
Writes a file to the local filesystem.

Usage:
- Overwrites the existing file if one exists.
- Existing files must be read with the read tool before overwrite.
- Prefer editing existing files rather than rewriting them when possible.
- Creates parent directories for new files when needed.

content.description: The content to write to the file

filePath.description: The path to the file to write

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Thay old_content bằng new_content trong một file.

old_content.description: Nội dung cũ cần tìm và thay thế.

new_content.description: Nội dung mới dùng để thay thế.

function.name: glob
function.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports patterns like **/*.js and src/**/*.ts. Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: Directory to search. Defaults to the active repository.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents using a regular expression. Supports an include glob and returns matching file paths and line numbers.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the active repository.

include.description: Optional file glob such as "*.js" or "*.{ts,tsx}"

function.name: webfetch
function.description:
Fetches content from a specified URL.

Usage notes:
- The URL must be a fully-formed valid URL.
- Format options: "markdown" (default), "text", or "html".
- This tool is read-only and does not modify any files.
- Results may be summarized if the content is very large.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from

format.description: The format to return. Defaults to markdown.

function.name: todowrite
function.description:
Create and maintain a structured task list for the current coding session.

States:
- pending
- in_progress
- completed
- cancelled

status.description: Current status: pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled
